I posted the answers in #coastal-team, addressed to you. My first post overstated the takeover: it said the sources don't name a new owner, but they point to Bettina. I posted a correction right after it, so please use the second post for that point.

- **Takeover:** Moss's Oct 5, 2025 note says the account changed hands on Monday, Oct 6, 2025. Bettina's Nov 17, 2025 message calls it "Sofia's old grocery account," which suggests Bettina took it over. No CRM owner record is in the files I can read, so confirm with Bettina before filing.
- **Discount:** 10%. Bettina posted 12% on Nov 17, 2025, then corrected it to 10% in the same thread. I found no signed contract in the account folder, so June Osei-Lark is the person to confirm it on paper.
- **Ticket:** PD-4827, opened by Kwame on Oct 15, 2025 for Corinne's missing admin rights in Pemberline Dock.
